PetPal Care Hub

PetPal Care Hub is a smart pet safety and care platform for pet owners. Keep pets safe, connected and cared for with NFC pet identification, GPS pet tracking, digital pet profiles, lost-pet recovery tools, and pet-friendly places and services.

  • GPS pet trackers for live location
  • NFC pet tags for tap-to-identify profiles
  • Lost pet safety and recovery help
  • Pet-friendly places and local services
  • Shop NFC tags, GPS trackers and care plans
  • Discover pet care features and community tips
  • Contact PetPal support
